correct.zh: 列I（销售构成比率累计）是在把单元格A2〜H11以列B（销售额）为关键字降序排列之后才计算的，因此要按销售额从大到小依次累加构成比率。丁28.8% → 丙51.3%（28.8+22.5）→ 甲66.1%（+14.8）→ 癸76.9%（+10.8），累计落在70%以内的是「商品丁、商品丙、商品甲」这3个品目。再看这3个品目的商品周转率：丁=9.2次、丙=12.0次、甲=14.4次，满足「10次以下」的只有商品丁。因此重点商品为1个品目，正确答案是ア。要点在于把「累计70%以内」和「周转率10次以下」这两个条件按AND（两者都满足）来筛选。
correct.en: Column I (cumulative sales composition ratio) is calculated after cells A2 to H11 have been sorted in descending order by column B (sales), so the composition ratios are added up in order from the largest sales. D 28.8% → C 51.3% (28.8+22.5) → A 66.1% (+14.8) → J 76.9% (+10.8), so the items whose cumulative ratio stays within 70% are the three items Product D, Product C, and Product A. Next, looking at the inventory turnover ratios of these three: D = 9.2 times, C = 12.0 times, A = 14.4 times, and only Product D meets the condition of 10 times or less. Therefore there is 1 priority product, and the correct answer is ア. The key point is to narrow down using the two conditions, cumulative ratio within 70% and turnover ratio of 10 times or less, joined by AND (both must hold).

distractors.zh: 要得到2个品目，需要把累计70%的范围再放宽一个品目、把商品癸（累计76.9%、周转率14.0次）也算进来等情形；但癸既超过70%，周转率也超过10次，所以不在对象之内。在累计70%以内的丁、丙、甲当中，周转率10次以下的只有丁，不会是2个品目。
distractors.en: Two items would result if, for example, the 70% cumulative range were widened by one more item to include Product J (cumulative 76.9%, turnover 14.0 times). But J exceeds 70% and its turnover is also over 10 times, so it is out of scope. Among D, C, and A, which are within the 70% cumulative ratio, only D has a turnover of 10 times or less, so the answer is not 2.

distractors.zh: 3个品目是只用「累计70%以内」这一个条件筛选出的丁、丙、甲的个数。这是忘记再叠加「周转率10次以下」这第二个条件的错误，丙（12.0次）和甲（14.4次）应被排除。
distractors.en: Three items is the count of D, C, and A, obtained by filtering with only the condition of a cumulative ratio within 70%. It is the mistake of forgetting to also apply the second condition of a turnover ratio of 10 times or less; C (12.0 times) and A (14.4 times) are excluded.

distractors.zh: 4个品目是把降序排列后的前4件（丁、丙、甲、癸）直接数出来的个数。加入癸后累计变为76.9%，超过70%，而且其周转率为14.0次，也不满足10次以下的条件，因此是错误的。
distractors.en: Four items is the count obtained by simply taking the top four after sorting in descending order (D, C, A, and J). Including J makes the cumulative ratio 76.9%, which exceeds 70%, and its turnover ratio of 14.0 times does not satisfy the 10-times-or-less condition either, so this is wrong.

points.zh: 销售构成比率累计采用的是ABC 分析（帕累托图）的思路：先按销售额降序排列，再从上往下依次累加构成比率。排序顺序一旦弄错，所有累计值都会随之偏移。
points.en: The cumulative sales composition ratio follows the idea of ABC analysis (Pareto chart): first sort by sales in descending order, then add up the composition ratios from the top downward. If the sort order is wrong, every cumulative value shifts as well.

points.zh: 当抽取条件有多个时，要作为AND 条件叠加筛选。这里先用「累计70%以内」缩小到3个品目，再用「商品周转率10次以下」缩小到1个品目。商品周转率＝销售额÷平均库存额。
points.en: When there are multiple extraction conditions, apply them together as AND conditions. Here, the cumulative ratio within 70% narrows it to three items, and the inventory turnover ratio of 10 times or less narrows it further to one item. Inventory turnover ratio = sales ÷ average inventory.
